name: fchmod
description: The fchmod() system call changes the mode bits of a file specified by an open file descriptor. It sets the file permissions, set-user-ID, set-group-ID, and sticky bits as defined in the mode parameter.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor referring to the file whose mode is to be changed

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Bit mask specifying the new file mode bits, including permissions and special flags

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error
